Location Ad Dakhiliyah, Nizwa 611, OmanVIEW ON MAP

Accountable for overall success of the daily kitchen operations. Exhibits culinary talents by personally performing tasks while leading the staff and managing all food related functions. Works to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction while maximizing the financial performance in all areas of responsibility. Supervises all kitchen areas to ensure a consistent, high quality product is produced. Responsible for guiding and developing staff including direct reports. Must ensure sanitation and food standards are achieved. Areas of responsibility comprise overseeing all food preparation areas (e.g., banquets, room service, restaurants, bar/lounge and employee cafeteria) and all support areas (e.g., dish room and purchasing).
q: High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
Provides direction for all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees' absence or determine appropriate replacement to fill gaps.
Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
Demonstrate new cooking techniques and equipment to staff.
Setting and Maintaining Goals for Culinary Function and Activities
Develops and implements guidelines and control procedures for purchasing and receiving areas.
Establishes goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
Communicates the importance of safety procedures, detailing procedure codes, ensuring employee understanding of safety codes, monitoring processes and procedures related to safety.
Manages department controllable expenses including food cost, supplies, uniforms and equipment.
Participates in the budgeting process for areas of responsibility.
Knows and implements the brand's safety standards.
r: Monitors the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
Determines how food should be presented, and create decorative food displays.
Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
Ensures employees maintain required food handling and sanitation certifications.
Maintains purchasing, receiving and food storage standards.
Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
Provides and supports service behaviors that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.

Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service. Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters. Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities

Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.

Administers the performance appraisal process for direct report managers.

Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and or managers.
Manages employee progressive discipline procedures for areas of responsibility.

Provides information to executive teams, managers and supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

Yokogawa, award winner for ‘Best Asset Monitoring Technology’ and ‘Best Digital Twin Technology’ at the HP Awards, is a leading provider of industrial automation, test and measurement, information systems and industrial services in several industries.

Our aim is to shape a better future for our planet through supporting the energy transition, (bio)technology, artificial intelligence, industrial cybersecurity, etc. We are committed to the United Nations sustainable development goals by utilizing our ability to measure and connect.

Our 18,000 employees work in over 60 countries with one corporate mission, to "co-innovate tomorrow". We are looking for dynamic colleagues who share our passion for technology and care for our planet. In return, we offer you great career opportunities to grow yourself in a truly global culture where respect, value creation, collaboration, integrity, and gratitude are highly valued and exhibited in everything we do.
Lead the tax function across Yokogawa Middle East & Africa, ensuring timely compliance, effective tax planning and optimization, and practical advice to the business.
Based in Bahrain, manage external tax advisers, lead the Regional Tax Accountant and coordinate with Country Finance Managers and Africa Finance owners.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation or a related discipline; CPA, ACCA, CTA or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
~10 years of progressive taxation experience, including responsibility for tax compliance or advisory matters across multiple jurisdictions.
Strong knowledge of direct and indirect taxes, international tax, transfer pricing and tax accounting; multinational experience preferred.
Experience managing external tax advisers and partnering with commercial and senior management teams.
Strong tax technical judgment, integrity, analytical skills and commercial awareness.
Ability to translate tax requirements into practical recommendations and business decisions.
Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, team leadership & problem solving capabilities.
Proficient in Excel and ERP systems, with clear written and spoken English communication.
The ability to present not only problems, but also solutions and clear recommendations.

r: Lead regional tax governance covering corporate income tax, Zakat, VAT/GST, withholding, customs, excise, payroll related taxes and other applicable levies.
Maintain entity tax profiles and a consolidated compliance calendar for filings, registrations, payments and statutory deadlines across the Middle East & Africa.
Review tax returns, key reconciliations, technical positions and supporting evidence before submission by authorized local representatives.
Monitor changes in tax laws, compliance risks and overdue obligations; escalate exceptions and coordinate corrective actions.
Tax Planning, Optimization and Cash Tax Management
Develop lawful strategies to optimize tax liabilities, effective tax rates and cash taxes.
Assess incentives, exemptions, losses, treaty relief, tax credits and recoveries, documenting benefits and risks.
Evaluate tax implications of dividends, financing, restructuring, intercompany arrangements and investments.
Coordinate tax payment and refund forecasts with regional Cash Management.
International Tax, Transfer Pricing and Tax Accounting
Oversee transfer pricing policies, related party documentation and applicable local and group disclosures.
Coordinate Pillar Two, DMTT, CbCR, CFC, permanent establishment and economic substance requirements where applicable.
Review current and deferred tax provisions, tax balances, uncertain positions and material financial statement disclosures with entity Finance teams.
Partner with Sales, Projects, Legal, Procurement and Supply Chain to assess tax implications of tenders, contracts, variations and business decisions.
Advise on project VAT, withholding taxes, import duties, cross border services, subcontracting and permanent establishment risks.
Review contractual tax clauses and recommend compliant options to protect project margins.
Tax Advisers, Authorities and Tax Audits
Lead the selection, appointment and performance management of external tax advisers, subject to required approvals and processes.
Agree service scope, deliverables and deadlines; review the quality of advice, tax filings, professional fees and provider performance.
Coordinate tax audits, authority inquiries, assessments, disputes, objections, appeals and refund claims with relevant stakeholders.
Maintain documentary evidence, filing confirmations and an active tax risk and issue register.
Team Leadership, Stakeholder Support and Reporting
Manage and develop the Regional Tax Accountant, ensuring clear responsibilities, suitable review controls and knowledge transfer.
Work with Country Finance Managers and Africa Finance owners to obtain accurate data while preserving local accounting and statutory signatory responsibilities.
Provide the CFO with regular regional tax compliance, exposure and optimization reporting, including material issues, financial impact and recommended action.

d: We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead the delivery of some of Yellow Door Energy's largest and most complex commercial and industrial (C&I) energy projects in Bahrain. You will be based in Manama as part of our Project Execution team. You will take end-to-end accountability for safe delivery, programme, budget, quality, contractor performance and stakeholder management, from pre-construction and EPC mobilisation through to commissioning and handover.
These projects are significantly larger in scale and capital value than a typical C&I installation, with technical, contractual and stakeholder complexity to match.

The role combines office-based work with regular time on site and close client interaction. You will need to be as effective leading a progress review with an EPC contractor as you are presenting project performance to senior leadership.

This role suits an experienced project leader who can take ownership of complex delivery, lead multidisciplinary teams and EPC partners, and keep clear control of programme, cost, risk and contractual performance.
Lead the project execution plan, covering scope, work breakdown structure, programme, resources, procurement interfaces and key milestones.
Provide constructability, cost and schedule input during pre-construction, and take part in EPC and major subcontractor evaluation and negotiations.
Coordinate design readiness, permitting, grid connection and authority requirements so projects mobilise on time.
Set up project governance, reporting, document control and a live risk and issue register before construction begins.
Lead EPC contractor performance through structured progress reviews, look-ahead planning and timely issue resolution.
Manage programme, budget, cost forecasting and variance, taking corrective action when performance moves away from plan.
Control scope and change, assessing programme, cost, contractual and technical impacts before changes are approved.
Work with YDE's Technical team on design reviews, ensuring engineering decisions support constructability and programme.
Drive QA/QC, inspections, testing and mechanical completion, with visible QHSSE leadership throughout.
Act as YDE's senior project interface with clients, EPC contractors, consultants, suppliers, authorities and utilities.
Manage variations, claims, notices, payment-related delivery inputs and contractor performance issues, escalating material matters where needed.
Lead the multidisciplinary project team, and coach Project Managers, Site Engineers and other team members to promote consistent execution practice.
Report clearly to senior leadership on schedule, cost, quality, HSE, commercial and stakeholder risks.
Plan and coordinate commissioning, performance testing and authority or grid acceptance.
Lead punch-list closure, PAC/FAC and Defects Liability Period requirements, and formal handover to Asset Management and O&M.
Run post-project reviews and feed lessons learned into future project planning.
A bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical or Civil Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline.
At least 10 years' project management experience in construction, EPC, renewable energy or power infrastructure.
A track record of leading major renewable energy, power or infrastructure projects through construction, commissioning and handover.
Experience managing EPC contractors, multidisciplinary teams, project controls and complex stakeholder interfaces.
Sound commercial and contractual judgement across variations, claims, change control, budgets and delivery risk.
Technical understanding of solar PV and grid-connected energy projects, sufficient to challenge and coordinate engineering outputs from a delivery and constructability perspective.
Experience working with utilities and authorities in the GCC or a comparable multi-stakeholder regulatory environment.
Experience working effectively in a multinational, matrix organisation.
Experience with BESS, hybrid energy or complex grid-interconnection projects.
Working knowledge of Primavera P6 and/or MS Project.
You take ownership of complex, high-value projects and keep clear control of programme, cost and risk.
You can challenge contractors, plans and technical assumptions while keeping working relationships constructive.
You spot risks early and make balanced decisions when delivery conditions change.
You build credibility in each of your working settings: on site, with clients and in the office.
You lead with clear expectations and accountability, while staying close enough to the detail to resolve issues effectively.
You will lead some of YDE's largest and most complex C&I energy projects, with accountability from mobilisation through to commissioning and handover.

The role offers broad exposure across technical delivery, EPC management, commercial and contractual matters, project controls and senior stakeholder engagement. You will work closely with colleagues in Project Execution, Technical, Commercial, Procurement and PMO, QHSSE, Legal, Finance and O&M, and help shape how YDE delivers major projects through the practices and lessons you bring to the team.

Yellow Door Energy is the leading sustainable energy partner for commercial and industrial businesses across the Middle East and Africa. We deliver sustainable energy solutions through power purchase agreements and solar leases, helping businesses reduce energy costs, improve power reliability and lower carbon emissions.
Our solutions include solar PV, battery energy storage systems, hybrid energy and energy efficiency. Our shareholders include Actis, Mitsui & Co, TAEF and the International Finance Corporation.

If you are an experienced project leader with a track record of delivering major renewable energy, power or infrastructure projects, and you can confidently manage EPC delivery, project controls, commercial risk and complex stakeholder interfaces, we'd love to hear from you.
Let's lead the charge in sustainable energy solutions together.

Problem-solving skills with the ability to make quick decisions during event operations.
Team player with a proactive and results-driven attitude.
Excellent time management and follow-up skills.
